beef.Global: New Zealand lean beef import benchmark; not supermarket beef.
beef.Australia: Sydney beef and veal CPI only; no monetary retail price imported.
beef.China: Existing 2024 quarterly and Jan–Feb 2025 wholesale figures are outside the priority window. MOA monitoring is a candidate; a reusable 2026 series was not verified.

crude.Global: World Bank monthly Brent and EIA daily Brent kept separate.
crude.Australia: FuelCheck contains retail petrol/diesel, not crude oil. Converted Brent is not an Australian domestic price.
crude.China: Converted Brent and NDRC refined-fuel adjustments are not domestic crude spot prices; no matching series imported.

gold.Global: World Bank spot benchmark; not jewellery retail prices.
gold.Australia: Legacy AUD values converted from USD at a fixed 2026 rate are not domestic historical transactions. No domestic series verified.
gold.China: Shanghai Gold Exchange historical-data access could not be verified in this run; no fabricated substitute.

copper.Australia: Legacy FX-converted international benchmark excluded; no matching Australian domestic series verified.
copper.China: NBS electrolytic copper 1# wholesale monitoring; ten-day periods, not a monthly LME equivalent.

beans.Global: ICO Arabica and Robusta prices kept separate.
beans.Australia: Existing import unit values mix grades and contracts; broad coffee/tea/cocoa CPI is not coffee-specific. Neither is substituted for a coffee price.
beans.China: Existing trade unit values are price proxies and mix product grades. No comparable domestic coffee price series verified.

cotton.Global: Cotlook A physical-price benchmark in USD/kg; its name does not make it a base-100 price index.
cotton.Australia: Existing export value/weight ratios are mix-sensitive unit-value proxies, not fixed-grade prices. No domestic series verified.
cotton.China: NBS white grade 3 lint cotton in CNY/tonne; distinct from Cotlook A and 3128B monthly series.

memory.Global: DRAMeXchange historical downloads require membership and redistribution permission. No licensed DDR4 history imported; editorial context retained.
memory.Australia: DRAMeXchange historical downloads require membership and redistribution permission. No licensed DDR4 history imported; editorial context retained.
memory.China: DRAMeXchange historical downloads require membership and redistribution permission. No licensed DDR4 history imported; editorial context retained.

milk.Global: World Bank Pink Sheet does not provide a directly matching fresh/raw milk series; milk powder is a different product.
milk.Australia: Sydney milk CPI only; not an AUD/litre shelf price or farmgate milk price.
milk.China: Legacy annual/year-end raw-milk figures are not a monthly series. No reusable 2026 historical series verified; manual MOA review required.

shirt.Global: No verified same-specification T-shirt price history. Apparel trade unit values, clothing CPI and cotton input prices are not T-shirt retail prices.
shirt.Australia: No verified same-specification T-shirt price history. Apparel trade unit values, clothing CPI and cotton input prices are not T-shirt retail prices.
shirt.China: No verified same-specification T-shirt price history. Apparel trade unit values, clothing CPI and cotton input prices are not T-shirt retail prices.

shuttle.Global: No global standard-grade shuttlecock benchmark verified.
shuttle.Australia: Legacy AS-30 recollection and greater-than-AUD70 quote are a range/lower bound, not exact historical observations.
shuttle.China: Legacy AS-05 quotes span 2024–2025, mix sales channels and lack a verified 2026 history; not comparable with AS-30.
